question: Which exact 3.1.190 entry point posts a system notification (lvx_notification_insert_message), what message struct does it consume, who owns the strings, from which thread may it be called, and what icon files does it accept?
prototype_hypothesis: Port record 0xC4F1F28 (EVID-PORT-9190-001) with the Band 10 Pro 3.101.043 int(const firmware_notification_message *) contract and 88-byte layout.
callsite_evidence: Entry 0xC4F1F28 (Thumb, PUSH.W {R4-R8,LR}): NULL branch logs '[%s] %s: Msg is NULL' with tag notification_manager and __func__ 'lvx_notification_insert_message' (literal 0xC4F1FF8 -> 0x2C79B4A2); the reminder branch logs under 'lvx_notification_start_reminder'. The port address is confirmed.

0xC4F1F28 -> lvx_notification_init_message 0xC45CD2C: malloc(88) 0xC0F1170, memcpy 88, +0x2c == 0 -> current seconds (0xC4E169C), +0x20 NULL -> 'S:/system/image/notifications/default_small.bin', +0x1c NULL -> 'S:/system/image/notifications/default.bin', both replaced by lv_mem strdup copies (0xC45AA42).
-> insert_message 0xC463440 ('insert message the uid is %llu, id is %lu' with u64 +0x00 / u32 +0x08): per-uid group in lv_ll 0x200A406C, at most 10 messages per uid, node filled by 0xC45CB98.

After insert: 0xC45B67C (list trim/timer); if u8 +0x50 != 0 a one-entry copy list is published as event 29 type 7 through 0xC43466C(29, &0x200CB740, 1); uv_timer_start 0xC119A74(0x200CB6D0, 0xC45B228, 500, 0); 0xC45B658 frees the temporary.

Lockscreen reminder view create_lockscreen_view 0xC2B3E74: label +0x0c coloured with u32 +0x34 (0 -> 0xFFFFFFFF), icon +0x1c via notifications_set_icon 0xC2A9368 (lv_img_set_src 0xC2617D8). Detail page 0xC2AD5E4: if +0x48 != 0 calls +0x48(copy, parent, copy->+0x54), else focus view 0xC4BAD60 when u8 +0x52 != 0, else draw_message_detail 0xC4BAA30 (icon +0x1c, title +0x10, body +0x14, time +0x2c, button +0x24 with callback +0x3c, order u8 +0x51). Detail on_destroy 0xC2A8E50 calls +0x4c(copy) when non-NULL. Notification-centre item 0xC2B498C: small icon +0x20, header +0x0c, title +0x10, body +0x14, text height cached in u16 +0x30.

+0x54 readers: run_custom_vibration 0xC2AF80C, draw_focus_toast_ui 0xC2AF5C4, ignore handlers 0xC2A6F68/0xC2AE608 (write byte +12 of the context) null-check it; on_clear_all_clicked 0xC2AD424 and update_message_small_icon 0xC2A9100 dereference it without a check when u8 +0x52 != 0 or when uid bit 63 is set (phone-originated).

Stock callers (21 xrefs) use the same slots: add_miss_notification 0xC4B52C0 (+0x0c 'phone.appname', +0x10 'missed.phone', +0x14 caller, +0x1c '.rle', +0x20 '.bin'); weather 0xC31AACC (+0x38 = 0, +0x48/+0x4c callbacks); ephemeris 0xC2C85E4 (+0x34 colour 0xFFFF4D63); OTA on_reminder_silent_ota_destroy 0xC2B0840 (+0x48/+0x4c callbacks, +0x54 user data), an LVGL page callback.
control_flow_evidence: lv_gpu_decoder_info 0xC2678D4: .bin/.evo/.gpu files must carry a 4-byte lv_img_header_t with cf 4..14 or 0x10/0x12

fields.meaning: uid: group key; bit 63 marks phone-originated (then +0x54 is dereferenced unchecked)
app/source name: header line in lockscreen view and list
icon for lockscreen reminder and detail (NULL -> S:/system/image/notifications/default.bin)
small icon for the notification-centre list (NULL -> default_small.bin)
text-height cache, written by the list view, not copied
ARGB accent colour for the header (0 -> white)

fields.required: NULL (or a valid zeroed 16-byte context; the firmware may write byte +12)

ownership_analysis: The firmware copies the 88-byte struct and strdups every string before returning; caller storage may be on the stack and released after the call. Strings over 512 bytes are truncated.
context_analysis: Unlocked lv_ll list, uv timers on the app loop initialised in miwear_init_appdata and a synchronous event-29 publish that builds the reminder page: UI/app-loop thread only. Stock callers include LVGL page callbacks (OTA destroy) and app event handlers.
icon_analysis: Icons are file paths for lv_img_set_src. Stock uses 'S:/system/image/...' (drive S) plus .rle files for the missed-call icon; the Supervisor's '/data/canopus/manager_icon.bin' form is already shown by this firmware's launcher (docs/v8-manager-bringup.md). The vglite decoder requires a v8 lv_img_header_t (cf bits 0-4, w 10-20, h 21-31) with cf 4..14 or 0x10/0x12 for .bin; a v9 header (0x19) is cf 25 and rejected. 32-bit colour build: TRUE_COLOR_ALPHA is 4 bytes/pixel, as scripts/convert_manager_icon.py writes without --rgb565. NULL icons get firmware defaults.
differences_from_043: Field offsets match the Supervisor's .043 struct exactly (start_reminder +0x50, callback_data +0x54, open/destroy callbacks +0x48/+0x4c).
+0x0c is the app/source line and +0x10 the title; the .043 struct names +0x0c 'title' and +0x10 'source'.
The return value is free() residue; treat it as void instead of testing < 0.
Icons need the v8 header (cf 5, ARGB8888) and the .bin extension.
unsafe_assumptions: +0x38/+0x40/+0x44 semantics inferred from stock writers; all zero for the Supervisor's use.
That the Supervisor UI task runs on the same app loop is inferred from LVGL page callbacks calling this function; not observed on a device.
recommended_probe: Mirage (emulator evidence only): post one notice from the Manager UI with +0x50 = 1 and all callbacks NULL; confirm popup and notification-centre entry; then on a device.
